title: Industrial CIO Operating Review
audience: CIO, COO, CISO, Quality, Finance and executive committee
decision_request: Decide whether the current production-system modernization path can continue, what must be escalated, and which actions can be drafted under governed autonomy.
meeting_notes: ERP cutover remains targeted for quarter end, but MES interface testing is incomplete.
Quality team says change-control evidence for the validated reporting process is not complete.
Production leadership reports two lines depend on a legacy shopfloor integration with limited support.
Digital order channel availability is business-critical during the seasonal demand peak.
Sponsor wants to avoid an executive escalation before the next operating review.
risk_register: IOT-12: MES interface readiness, Red, owner Manufacturing IT, mitigation not approved.
QMS-07: Validated report change evidence incomplete, Amber, owner Quality Systems.
SEC-18: Shared privileged account found on shopfloor support workstation, Amber, owner CISO office.
VEN-04: Integration vendor support contract expires in 60 days, Amber, owner Procurement.
budget_update: Additional test environment capacity is not funded.
Vendor day-rate increase is pending procurement approval.
context: Executive committee update is due in 10 days.
No production, network, security or validated-system change should be executed without explicit approval.
Leadership needs a production-continuity view, audit evidence pack and action ledger.
